prompt: Review the responsive form change in evals/files/responsive-draft-project. The layout switches by replacing the form markup, the input currently holds an in-progress draft, and the project declares no minimum input-size rule. Report the user-visible risks and the smallest source-level corrections to preserve.
expected_output: The review preserves the in-progress draft across the wide/narrow layout change instead of allowing the input remount to discard it. Because the project declares no input-size rule, it keeps the coarse-pointer text input at least 16 CSS pixels so focusing the field does not trigger automatic zoom. It also identifies the rendered states that still need verification.
assertions: The wide/narrow layout change preserves the in-progress draft rather than discarding it with the remounted input.
With no project rule, the coarse-pointer text input remains at least 16 CSS pixels to avoid focus zoom.
The review identifies the affected rendered draft and focused-input states that still need verification.
The review does not treat the source correction as rendered acceptance.
